title: Your Life at Every Level of a Trader: $1,000 to $1 Billion
alts: Every Level of Trader, From Your Phone to a $1 Billion Fund
The Richer the Trader, the Less They Trade
hook: At level one, you trade fifty times a day. At level ten, you might trade twice a year. From a free app on your phone to a billion-dollar fund: what each level of trading actually looks like, what it pays, and what ends you.
sources: Chague, De-Losso & Giovannetti, 'Day Trading for a Living?' (2019): 97% of Brazilian day traders who persisted 300+ days lost money; ~1.1% earned more than the minimum wage
Barings collapse after Nick Leeson's hidden losses, 1995
George Soros's fund and the British pound, September 1992 (profit reported at about $1 billion)
Warren Buffett, Berkshire Hathaway 1988 shareholder letter: 'our favorite holding period is forever'
Prop-firm, bank-desk and hedge-fund details are typical, illustrative descriptions
tags: day trading, trader levels, every level of trader, prop firm, hedge fund, 2 and 20, leverage, trading psychology, Warren Buffett, trading documentary
pinned: Which level are you on right now? And how many trades did you make last week?
notes: The US 'pattern day trader' $25,000 rule is being replaced (FINRA change effective June 2026), so the film uses leverage instead for level 2.
